Name: NPC Warp Totem
Author: Amichwan
Description:
[b]NPC Warp Totem[/b]

Teleport directly to your favorite NPCs safely and conveniently!
This mod adds a configurable warp totem that allows you to teleport directly to an NPC, skipping travel time and making social interactions faster.

[b][u]Main Features[/u][/b]

• [b]Direct NPC Teleport:[/b] Warp straight to any NPC you choose.
• [b]Configurable Recipe:[/b] Unlock the crafting recipe at any desired Foraging level, or use the default unlock at [b]Foraging Level 8[/b].
• [b]Smart Selection Menu:[/b] When using the totem, a menu appears letting you:
◦ Search for a specific NPC by name
◦ Change the sort order with [i]Tab[/i] between alphabetical and friendship hearts
◦ Save NPCs to a [b]Favorites[/b] list for quick access
• [b]Safe Teleportation:[/b] You are prompted to confirm travel before teleporting, and the totem is not consumed if you exit the menu. Teleports are designed to avoid unsafe locations.
• [b]Friendship Requirement:[/b] Only NPCs with at least 2 hearts of friendship appear in the selection list.

[b][u]Compatibility & Restrictions[/u][/b]

• [b]Mod Compatibility:[/b] The mod should work with NPCs added by other mods.
• [b]Access Special Zones:[/b] In some cases, teleporting to an NPC may place you in areas that are normally inaccessible in vanilla gameplay, such as “ghost” zones where the NPC appears at specific times. Use caution, as these areas may be out of bounds in normal circumstances.
